what: On first open, a number beside the name in the center of a black curtain fills from 0 to 100. The target goes to 12, then 52 when fonts arrive, 92 when the document is fully loaded, and 100 when both are in (forced to 100 at 5s). The number approaches its target by 1 − e^(−dt/160) per frame. Its color passes straight through orange → peach → sand → gray → sky → blue dusk along the progress. After it passes 99.35 and .4s elapses, it shows 100 for .1s, the text vanishes, and the curtain lifts upward over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.9,0,.1,1). When fully lifted it fires fx:done, and the Hero entrance hooks onto that. Runs once per window.

options.dur: Duration in seconds for the curtain to lift, default 1.6 — shorten for frequently opened screens
options.hold: Length in seconds to stop at 100, default .1
options.every: If true, runs every time it opens even in the same window — by default only once (afterwards fx:done fires right away with no cover)
options.--fx-tint-1 … --fx-tint-7: (css variable) number color — 0 is 7, 100 is 1. Default is a sunset made by rotating from --kf-accent

note: The original also raises 86 when one hero image arrives — the part watches only two things: fonts and document. The original skips the curtain when entering via page navigation (the part runs once per same window)
